headline: Oracle Stock Falls as Company Details $20 Billion Raising Plan
summary: Oracle's stock fell as the company detailed plans to raise $20 billion to help finance its AI cloud growth through borrowing and issuing stock.
why: Oracle is a major enterprise software and cloud computing company. Substantial capital-raising plans and debt issuance can impact equity valuations and investor sentiment regarding leverage.
